assumptions: The frozen source tree is stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_RQ-VAE, copied into the owned candidate directory without modifying the source tree.
uncertainty_agreement expects encoded views [M,B,D] and discrete tuples [M,B,L]; variance is summed across latent dimensions, matching squared L2 distance.
The discrete disagreement indicator is non-differentiable; its variance weight is detached. Model gradients must come from paired RQ reconstruction and commitment losses, not the indicator itself.
